questions.explain: Vectored yaw provides yaw in hover by tilting the motors.

options: All motors tilt except the tail one

questions.q: Why can a motor spin up without a command during a channel check?
options: Motor and servo outputs are swapped
Yaw rate loop P is too high
questions.explain: A motor function is assigned to an output physically connected to a servo, and vice versa. The output map is built by hand with props off.

questions.q: Why can't you mix a DShot motor and a 50 Hz servo on one timer?
options: You can, there are no restrictions
You can if the servo and motor share one BEC
questions.explain: A timer group has one protocol and rate for all its outputs.

questions.q: What do you check on the ground before the first flight of a tilt-rotor?
options: Only that the aircraft arms in QHOVER
questions.explain: Smooth tilt, servo trims, directions: in MANUAL the motors point forward, in QSTABILIZE up.
75 and 76 — for vectored yaw; 41 — common tilt of the front motors.

options: The airspeed below which VTOL assists
The airspeed at which the VTOL → wing transition completes
